$comment: The one place the character lives. The frontend (avatar, still photo, UI copy) and the backend (voice, prompt, greeting, tests) both read this file. To change the character, edit character/name/voices and add the still photo the idle dock shows at frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp; roles is the label under the name for each of the agent's jobs (guide everywhere, booker on a listing's page). To add a language, add it to languages and voices (and give the brain written lines for it in backend/lines.py).
